items.source: groups - validation groups from determineValidationGroups(Object, Method)
items.translation: `groups` - 来自determineValidationGroups(Object, Method)的验证组

items.source: MethodValidationException - in case of unhandled errors.
items.translation: MethodValidationException - 在出现未处理的错误时。

items.source: target - the target Object
items.translation: target - 目标对象

items.source: method - the target method
items.translation: method - 目标方法

items.source: Delegate to validateArguments(Object, Method, MethodParameter[], Object[], Class[]) and handle the validation result, by default raising MethodValidationException in case of errors. Implementations may provide alternative handling, for example, injecting Errors into the method.
items.translation: 委托给 validateArguments(Object, Method, MethodParameter[], Object[], Class[]) 并处理验证结果，默认情况下在发生错误时抛出 MethodValidationException。实现可以提供替代的处理方式，例如将 Errors 注入到方法中。

items.source: Contract to apply method validation and handle the results. Exposes methods that return MethodValidationResult, and methods that handle the results, by default raising MethodValidationException.
items.translation: 用于应用方法验证并处理结果的契约。暴露返回 `MethodValidationResult` 的方法，以及默认抛出 `MethodValidationException` 来处理结果的方法。

items.source: Delegate to validateArguments(Object, Method, MethodParameter[], Object[], Class[]) and handle the validation result, by default raising MethodValidationException in case of errors.
items.translation: 委托给validateArguments(Object, Method, MethodParameter[], Object[], Class[])并处理验证结果，在发生错误时默认抛出MethodValidationException。

items.source: Delegate to validateReturnValue(Object, Method, MethodParameter, Object, Class[]) and handle the validation result, by default raising MethodValidationException in case of errors.
items.translation: 委托给validateReturnValue(Object, Method, MethodParameter, Object, Class[])并处理验证结果，默认情况下在发生错误时抛出MethodValidationException。

items.source: Delegate to validateReturnValue(Object, Method, MethodParameter, Object, Class[]) and handle the validation result, by default raising MethodValidationException in case of errors. Implementations may provide alternative handling.
items.translation: 委托给validateReturnValue(Object, Method, MethodParameter, Object, Class[])并处理验证结果，默认情况下在发生错误时抛出MethodValidationException。实现可以提供替代的处理方式。

items.source: Determine the applicable validation groups. By default, obtained from an @Validated annotation on the method, or on the class level.
items.translation: 确定适用的验证组。默认情况下，从方法上的 `@Validated` 注解或类级别获取。

items.source: Validate the given method arguments and return validation results.
items.translation: 验证给定的方法参数并返回验证结果。

items.source: Validate the given return value and return validation results.
items.translation: 验证给定的返回值并返回验证结果。

items.source: the result of validation
items.translation: 验证的结果

items.source: Determine the applicable validation groups.
items.translation: 确定适用的验证组。

items.source: the applicable validation groups as a Class array
items.translation: 作为Class数组的适用验证组

items.source: parameters - the parameters, if already created and available
items.translation: parameters - 如果已创建且可用，则为参数

items.source: arguments - the candidate argument values to validate
items.translation: arguments - 要验证的候选参数值

items.source: returnType - the return parameter, if already created and available
items.translation: returnType - 返回参数，如果已创建且可用

items.source: returnValue - the return value to validate
items.translation: returnValue - 要验证的返回值

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev
